_note: Wording for the For businesses page and the claim form. 'contact' is what the public sees: set email (a mailto address) or form (a link to a form), and optionally price. While both are empty the page says enquiries open soon. 'demo' is the placeholder shown only when the address ends in ?demo. 'counter.goatcounter' is the GoatCounter site code; empty means no visitor counting.
title: Put your business on the map
intro: This map shows the whole lake and the towns around it in 3D, with every marina, restaurant, shop and place to stay. People use it to find their way around and decide where to go.
free: Your business is probably on the map already, free. Open your pin and choose 'Claim or correct' to send your hours, website and anything we have wrong. You can also print a QR card that opens the map at your pin.
featured: A larger pin that is always on the map, even from far out
First place in your town's guide
Your own photo, a few lines in your words, and a link to your site
fine: An independent map, not affiliated with any community, utility or business shown.
purpose: WallyMap is the one map of Lake Wallenpaupack that shows everything in one place: the water, the shoreline, the communities and the businesses around it. It is free for anyone to use. The goal is simple: make it easier to find your way around the lake, and easier for the people who live and work here to be found.
now: Claim your pin and correct your hours, phone and links
Offers and specials shown on your pin
'Book or order' links to your reservation and delivery pages
A map of your location to embed on your own website
A printable QR card that opens the map at your door
coming: Featured pins: always visible, and first in your town's guide
A detailed layout of your property, as on the marinas and golf courses
A short video of your business on the map for your social media
A monthly report of how many people viewed your pin

communities.title: For lake communities
communities.intro: Seventy-eight lake communities are already named on the map, each with its own page. For homeowner and property owner associations, more is on the way.
now: Your community named and placed on the lake map
A guest link that opens the map at a specific house, for renters and visitors
coming: A private, detailed map just for your community: roads, amenities and lot numbers
Community events and notices shown to residents
Directions to a specific lot for emergency services and contractors
communities.fine: An independent map, not affiliated with any community or association shown. Private community maps are made with the association, not without it.

realtors.title: For real estate agents
realtors.intro: Buyers want to see where a home sits on the lake: which cove, how far from a marina, what is nearby. The map already answers that, and it carries housing market figures for the area. For agents and brokers, more is on the way.
now: Housing market figures for Pike and Wayne counties and the ZIP codes around the lake, updated monthly
A page for each of the 78 lake communities, with the nearest marinas, launches and places to eat
A link that opens the map at a specific house, to send to buyers
A map of any location to embed on your own listing pages
coming: Your listings and open houses as pins on the map
Every home for sale around the lake, updated daily from a licensed MLS feed, with a broker partner
A featured agent on the market and community pages
Market figures for each lake community
realtors.fine: An independent map, not affiliated with any brokerage, association or MLS. Listings will appear only under a proper data licence; none are copied from listing websites.
